notes.title: Why can I still buy Maze Crusher? / End of Development Update
notes.notes:
As you might have seen in the last announcement's discussion, some confusion has spread upon the announcement, which we want to clear up here:

In our last announcement we told, that we are going to disable sales upon further notice because we needed to stop development and it was not clear if, how and when development would continue.

By creating the said announcement, we made the first step in a defined process of steam. We then opened a ticket with steam, asking to suspend sales until we decide how to proceed (which is expected to be [b]at least[/b] half a year, most likely much longer).

While the future of Maze Cursher is still unclear, steam replied, that they will not disable sales for the given reason and asked us to add a note to the shop page and keep you updated instead.

So this is not our idea to change out minds from one day to the other, but it is a decision which has been made based on steam's standards and best practices.

[b]So how will this proceed?[/b]
Sales will not be disabled. We already adjusted the price of Maze crusher down a lot. So if anyone would like to have a look into the game, the new price now is an acceptable price point for the current state of the game.
This price will not be raised (might still undergo currency fluctuations) until we do a final decision and at least another game update. This is our promise.

This might now sound like a finaly try to make some money but this is not what this decision is made for. With this statement we want to communicate clearly, that the game[b] might probably not receive any further updates[/b] (worst case) or [b]might [/b]receive major changes in the future (including a complete redesign).

At the current point, the project is frozen and it's future is unclear. If you're interested, leave a wishlist but do only buy if you're actually willing to buy a long-term mystery box.

Sorry for the confusion. We will keep you updated as soon as further decisions are made or demand rises.

notes.title: Development has stopped
notes.notes:
We are sorry to inform our community that development on Maze Crusher will be stopped for now.

The reasons for this decision are mainly from private nature, but if you want to know more, there is some more detail on our discord server.

Finally, we might come back to Maze Crusher at a later time. But for now lights will go out and the option to buy Maze Crusher will be temporarily removed from steam until the final decision has been made.

Thank you for joining us on this journey so far and maybe it will continue in some time.

notes.title: Approaching the release...
notes.notes:
So, about one year after the "deadline 2.1" I am coming back to finally say that the worst part is over.

Today I am speaking to you as a human and as a developer. This is Alex wrtiting here.

As a solo-dev (Firesplash Entertainment is [b]mostly[/b] a one-man-show with some help from our community ans friends) the release "cycle" is strongly dependant on my life and work-life balance.

During the pandemic many things changed rapidly and there were a few more unexpected but massive changes in my primary work and my personal life situation within the last two years. This is why virtually any plan I made has been crossed - and this happened multiple times to me now.

The world is gliding from one crisis into the next and everything is affecting all our single lifes, so does it for me.

[b]What am I trying to say?[/b]
I am trying to give you some background on WHY I did not stick to any (self-)given deadline within this project since early 2020. This is not an excuse, this is an explaination.

[b]So how to proceed from here?[/b]
Some of you have already read it on our discord: The level editor is progressing and is now 90% functional. I am currently struggling with steam workshop implementation (this has turned out to be a hard piece of work) and I am hoping to bring this feature into closed beta some time near the year change, planning to release it to GA before the end of Quarter 1 of 2023

I know this feels like the next update coming in dec 2023 saying the same and prolonging again. I can't blame anyone for thinking like this (actually even I did so...) but while I was very inactive during the last months, I am confident that the upcoming few months will prove to be bettter.

That said we want to wish all of you a wonderful pre-christmas season and maybe I cna give you a next update on the progress as a christmas present.

notes.title: Current State of the Level Editor
notes.notes:
[i]Before reading: Our Fans who have joined our Discord server do already know some parts of this announcement.[/i]

We don't want to beat around the bush, so this is what this posting is about: We were not able keep the Q1 announcement up. Obviously.

As many of you know, Firesplash ENtertainment is not the main job of our team members. It is not even an employment as it is much too small to be able to employ people and live from the money we make. So actually we are creating games and other things besides our main work. I (Alex, the writer of this announcement) am the only programmer and the owner of Firesplash Entertainment. This means any release cycle is currently hard tied to the time I can invest into the projects.

The corona pandemic caused a lot of stress to all of us - for me that means having days of 11 and more hours of working time - which is the reason why I've often just been coming home tiredly. On top I got a huge private life project in planning phase right now which has huge impact on my further life and also on our Firesplash proejcts for the future. This is an essential thing and it is priorized.
We planned to have Maze Crusher out of early access before we started this project but the delays caused by the pandemic crashed all our time plans, so now the reduced spare time, the additional stress and the hugest update we ever made for maze crusher (from code side) are mixing up.

I know this sounds like "cheap excuses". I hate myself for doing exactly what I never wanted to do: Re-Prolonging a deadline for an announced release again and again - but implementing the level editor as well as the required technical backgrounds is seen from code side - as I already stated above - the hugest update we made yet.

If things go like they do right now and if no additional issues arise [b]we should be able to release the level editor and steam workshop integration into public access by the end of this year.[/b]

Currently the level editor itself is working quite well. There are a few bugs and some UI work left and the reference run (think of it like testing if your maze works) is not fully integrated yet.
The Steam Workshop implementation is still missing completely, I am right now working on this portion (for testing purpose: We need to know if things work like we expected before "sealing" the editor).
I would say the Editor is at 90%, Reference Run at 60% and Steam Workshop... Well... Right now 5%.
This makes a[b] total progress of about 60-70%[/b] as the editor and the reference mode itself are the biggest part of the upcoming update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33078670/99381eb6fa657f3c42059357aec657d014c1fb77.gif[/img]

Thank you very much for your support and understanding.

notes.title: Further Update Schedule
notes.notes:
Some of you might wonder about the Maze Crusher Roadmap:

First of all: [b]Of course we did not stop development.[/b]

The level editor is currently about 70% done.
We needed to change some priorities as of current situations. The corona pandemic made some strategic decisions necessary. We have a temporary focus change.
We expect the level editor to be ready for beta testing in q1/2021 - Remember, 2020 is only a few weeks left...

The last months created a huge wave of new streamers and growth on twitch and as some of you know, we have a twitch overlay game, which we wanted to extend. The current situation is perfect for growing it so we decided to put more efford into this project for the rest of 2020.

The next planned update for Maze Crusher (in Q1/2020) will bring a complete level editor and level sharing features so sorry for the development delay. We hope that you can understand this decision.

Stay home, Stay safe, Stay healthy.

notes.title: Visual Upgrade is OUT NOW
notes.notes:
Over the last months we focussed on a visual upgrade (besides the usual bugfixes).
This time there is not much to say because all the changes are obvious.

We improved nearly all the ingame graphics. Also this update introduces a new feature:
"Pimp My Dragon" - You can now colorize Kurisou!
How does you dragon look? Post a screenshot!

Also remember to [url=https://discord.gg/firesplash]join our discord server[/url]!

notes.title: 2020 GamePlay Update & Leaderboard Reset
notes.notes:
Today, we are publishing the new 2020 GamePlay Update.
In short, the last few months of development went mainly into:
[list]
[*] New kind of Enemy-Pathfinding. More efficient, stable and intelligent.
[*] Enemies can now trace through portals
[*] Better Score System
[*] New secondary attack to fight nearby enemies (fire wave)
[*] Finally - A brand new Game Mode: [b]Capture the Flag[/b]
[/list]

As of the amssive changes in enemy AI and scoring system we did a reset of all leaderboards - as announced previously.

So - Who will be the next "best maze crusher"?

notes.title: Thank you for 2019
notes.notes:
The year is almost over so it's time to say thank you and sorry.

We planned to release the new Capture The Flag GameMode until today but we encountered issues which held us apart. However we decided to release the version into testing brach so you can have a first look at it.
Please note it is known to be buggy in soime mazes and under some circumstances.

After all we want to thank you for playing Maze Crusher and sticking with it. We want to wish you a merry christmas and a good move into the new year 2020.

notes.title: A few Under-The-Hood-Fixes have been released
notes.notes:
Some players reported a pink walls issue. This issue is now resolved.
This happened when for any reason there have been issues finding out if there is a seasonal look to display.

Further there have been made some performace fixes under the hood which might slightly affect gameplay feeling positively.

You can now see small exclamation marks hovering over items you can interact with. Try it out!
Note: You can actually interact with some new objects which have no sense yet. Don't get confused :)

We plan to release a new feature until christmas. Stay tuned.

As always: If any bug occur, tell us! Thanks in advance and thanks for being a fan <3

notes.title: UPDATE: Seasons in Maze Crusher
notes.notes:
In our October-Update for Maze Crusher we implemented seasons.

This dos not mean we will start event passes and so on or even do battle events.
No - we're talking about styling the mazes. The first season will be halloween. You will notice that all mazes are now decorated for the upcoming halloween night.

Of course this is only cosmetic and way far from perfect but we also got some under-the-hood improvements.

[list]
[*]Upgraded the engine version for the project as of technical issues some of you reported
[*]Controller configuration is now themed better (seamless)
[*]Loading Screen / Intro is not so laggy anymore
[*]Fixed some issues with portals (sometimes you have been teleported wrong)
[*]Hopefully fixed controller config issue where you were not able to reassign some buttons -> Report if someone still got this issue!
[/list]

Unfortunately no new mazes this time. We simply did not have the time to create some quality mazes in the last weeks (as of ludum dare and different events).

Early Access Roadmap until the end of year:
[list]
[*]New Mazes
[*]Implement Puzzles
[*]Start working on CTF GameMode
[/list]

Any issues or other thoughts? We'd love to hear from you!
[url=https://discord.gg/firesplash]Join our discord community![/url]

notes.title: First alpha update - Please try and report your experience
notes.notes:
We just pushed an update to the testing branch containing requested features and improvements.

Changes:
[list]
[*]Higher Game-Speed (overall) as we decided yesterday that the game must be quicker for its arcade character. This will [b]not[/b] affect scores!
[*]Added Unconfined Mouse option for handicapped players as requested by "No Hands! Let's Play!"
[*]Some new mazes to evaluate. Try your best!
[*]Added hints above interactable objects when you are in range to interact with them.
[*]Fixed mouse behaviour in game pause menu
[/list]

As always if you want to report problems we'd appreciate you to directly open a ticket:
[url=https://git.firesplash.de/mazecrusher/MazeCrusherGame/issues]https://git.firesplash.de/mazecrusher/MazeCrusherGame/issues[/url]

If you want to give feedback or discuss the game and the changes the best way is our discord: [url=https://www.discord.gg/KRZ382n]Join it now![/url]

Of course you can also drop a topic here in the steam community!

[b]If you want to try the alpha release, you can activate it this way:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Go to your steam client's library
[*]Right-Click on "Maze Crusher"
[*]Click on "Properties" / "Eigenschaften"
[*]Click the ribbon "Betas" in the top right
[*]In the drop-down-menu select the "testing" branch
[*]Click the "Close" button
[*]Wait for the steam client to update the game
[*]Start the game and earn an achievement for participating in a beta ;)
[/olist]
Please note: If you do not encounter issues, you can leave the testing branch enabled. You will always receive bleeding edge updates then.

notes.title: Win a free Key /// Review Keys for media and Content Creators
notes.notes:
[h1]Win a Key[/h1]
It's now about one and a half month until our early access start.
We wanted to let you know, that you can win a free Maze Crusher key!
Head over to our twitter page for more information:
[url=https://twitter.com/FiresplashTV/status/1150843795187126272]https://twitter.com/FiresplashTV/status/1150843795187126272[/url]


[h1]Content Creators[/h1]
As a Streamer, YouTuber or similar you have two options for getting your hands on a free copy (and probably giveaway codes):

[b]Option 1: Release Party[/b]
We are looking for a hand full of streamers and YouTubers (other platforms as well) who want to do a stream/publish a video about Maze Crusher near our release date.
You'd get a key for your own usage as well as keys as a giveaway for your community.
More information and application: [url=https://forms.gle/8w3ovtERAjJpPECb8]https://forms.gle/8w3ovtERAjJpPECb8[/url]

If you - as a content creator - do not want to participate in the release party or you got declined for it, you can request a free key [b]for your own usage[/b] on KeyMailer or send us a mail with your curator link (for steam curators) to [b]press [/b]at [b]firesplash.de[/b].
[i]We will review requests on a case by case basis.[/i]


[h1]Media (Print, Blog, Online-Magazine)[/h1]
As a media representative you can request free review keys (including Pre-Access).
Please send us an email including the information for shat media you are requesting keys to [b]press[/b] at [b]firesplash.de[/b].

notes.title: Rescheduled Early Access start
notes.notes:
Some of you might already have noticed that we recently rescheduled the start of our early access period.

The reason is, that we changed wider parts of how the game works internally to be able to provide you with an even better experience starting with day one.
These changes require reworking nearly every asset int he game (basicly it changes how levels are loaded and how the maze works technically)
We hope you understand why we made this choice. We do not want to disgust our fans by publishing a low quality game to EA just to match our planned release date.

We wish all of you the best for your start into the fast approaching year 2019!

If you want to stay tuned with even more granular and internal info about us and our projects, make sure to follow us on twitter as well!
